title: Serve an observed EUR Llednar draw list
changes: Add the independently observed one-object Llednar list to the existing static OBJ source, retaining the prior dataset projection.
validation: Wine e152-llednar-list-wine-92rch9l_ preserves the E151 projection, checks all eight poisoned source bytes, mixed boundaries and the original draw, and passes three-frame interpreter/native-dispatch ordinary pairs with 155 typed requests and no raw reads per arm.

Read-only EUR creator-window fingerprint, literal 0809b238, call target 08022f10 and setter opcode check establishes a conditional producer writing 08395014 to object+28; its Llednar invocation is unproved. Initial opcode assertion used incorrect constants and was corrected. Focused Sol requested gpt-6.1-sol xhigh, effective settings unconfirmed.
Wine e152-llednar-list-cli-wine-inu0hb6h passes production CLI create/reuse/verify and one-frame startup; 102 other resource files match E151.
limitations: Ordinary use of the conditional producer, other producers, other scenes/consumers, per-read native attribution, frontend UI, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
